title: AWS Marketplace EventBridge Notification
description: Inbound AWS EventBridge event forwarded from the AWS Marketplace product's event bus. Authenticated out-of-band by the X-Traigent-Marketplace-Secret shared-secret header, not by anything in this body. The handler (src/services/billing/aws_marketplace/events.py:handle_marketplace_event) reads only `id`, `detail-type`, and `detail.CustomerAWSAccountId`; the rest of AWS's standard EventBridge envelope (version, source, account, time, region, resources, ...) may be present and is intentionally left unconstrained here, since AWS -- not Traigent -- owns that envelope shape.

id.description: AWS EventBridge event id. Used as the idempotency key (BillingEvent.event_id is unique); a missing/empty id is rejected as a malformed event (400).

detail-type.description: AWS EventBridge detail-type, e.g. "License Updated". Event types outside the resync set (RESYNC_EVENTS) are recorded and acknowledged (result="ignored") without triggering an entitlement resync.

CustomerAWSAccountId.description: AWS account id the event's customer/license is scoped to.
